title: The Emperor of All Maladies
author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
summary: Siddhartha Mukherjee, an oncologist, traces cancer from its earliest descriptions in antiquity to modern treatments, weaving the story of researchers and patients into a history of the disease and the fight against it.
readIf: you want a patient, humane and richly told history of medicine's long battle with one disease.
skipIf: you are facing a recent cancer diagnosis and want something gentler or more practical.
